producer_writer_exit.producer: Private Unix socket and HTTP gateway each authenticate QMI open/close before dispatching to the same bounded Rust handler; main retains the optional QMI retry worker.
producer_writer_exit.format: Typed JSON OpenRequest with control_path or empty close object; QMI core encodes service/client/transaction/message/TLV packet before a serialized transport write.
producer_writer_exit.writer: QmiState mutex serializes session selection/publication; macOS libusb claims one candidate and writes QMI frames to selected bulk endpoint after CTL_SYNC.
producer_writer_exit.exit: Private close fences retry; session close aggregates IMS/NAS/UIM and USB client result; client stops transport and joins reader; retry lifecycle stops/joins worker; main retains report. Unknown physical cleanup blocks reopen.

unresolved: Historical macOS QMI/MBIM supported models, firmware and operations are not recoverable from this current-code trace alone.
No DJI first-generation USB device is enumerated now; CTL_SYNC, unplug/re-enumeration, physical release and service behavior remain untested.
Only open/close/retry is traced here. Probe, set-ims, operator, broader producers and all P0 owner-map families remain outside this finite slice.
Software branch cases are not a frozen device/card/carrier instance registry or total product denominator.
